question: How do I book a workspace online?

blocks.text: On the public website, select a physical workspace from the map, then choose a permitted date, start time, and duration. Confirm the capacity, price, and session end time, and optionally rank eligible same-type alternatives.
Enter your first and last name and a reachable booking email, review the summary, and submit the request. No customer account is required; keep the displayed queue or reference number.
If the request is approved, follow the specific GCash or bank-transfer instructions sent to your email and upload proof of payment via the private link within 24 hours.

A confirmed booking is only established after staff verify your payment and assign a valid, non-overlapping physical unit. You will receive a final confirmation email identifying the actual workspace and schedule.

spans.quote: On the public customer website, select a physical named workspace from the map; select a permitted date, start time and duration; confirm capacity, price/pass and session end time (including the next date for overnight use); optionally rank eligible same-type alternatives; enter requested first/last name and a reachable booking email; review the summary and submit. No customer account is required. Keep the queue/reference displayed after submission.

A successful submission creates a pending request and queue number; it does not hold a unit. SKYDY aims to review website requests within 24 hours; the target is not automatic approval or an email-delivery guarantee. An initial approval allows payment but does not yet assign or confirm a physical unit. After payment-proof verification, final allocation must still find a valid non-overlapping unit from approved choices. Only an explicit final confirmation showing the actual physical unit and schedule establishes a confirmed booking. If all choices conflict, staff must follow the authorized recovery/reconciliation path; payment alone must not cause duplicate allocation.

Website reservations have no integrated card-payment gateway. Only after admin approval should a customer follow booking-specific GCash or bank-transfer instructions sent to the booking email. On-site shared kiosk walk-ins instead offer staff-handled cash or the currently displayed authorized static QR transfer, followed by staff verification. Website payment instructions must never be inferred from an old screenshot or kiosk QR.

An approved website request receives private payment instructions and a separate proof-upload link. The link is intended to be valid for 24 hours from issuance, not from original request submission and not the same as the admin 24-hour review target. Follow the actual deadline shown in the official email. A link is for the particular approved booking and must not be forwarded or publicly posted.

The documented proof form accepts one JPG/JPEG, PNG or WebP image up to 10 MB per submission. Use a legible genuine receipt that shows the transaction as requested; do not crop or alter it to misrepresent details, and conceal unrelated secrets when possible. File types or sizes outside the supported limit can fail. Successful upload acknowledgement means evidence was submitted, not that money was verified or the booking confirmed.

The final verified message identifies the actual booked workspace, time window and check-in directions. A bank receipt, payment QR, queue number, admin approval email or proof-upload success message is never independently a confirmed reservation.
